# 0063: A run that never reached the model is an error, and a model that ignores effort refuses a rung

Status: accepted, 2026-10-07.
Refines [0012](0012-grading-is-composable-not-prescribed.md) (grading is composable, not prescribed) with a check before the grader runs.
Extends [0049](0049-effort-is-the-third-matrix-axis.md) (effort is the third matrix axis) to a model whose CLI ignores the rung.

## Context

Two findings from the first effort sweep.

Twenty-nine claude cells hit the subscription's session limit.
The CLI exited 1 with the message "You've hit your session limit", made no model call and spent nothing.
The grader then ran against an untouched workspace and failed.
So the report showed 29 fails of the skill that were never attempts at the task.

Haiku 4.5 was swept at all five effort rungs.
Its reasoning tokens and cost stayed flat from low to max.
Every other model scaled clearly: Sonnet 5 went from 5k to 100k reasoning tokens.
Claude Code accepts `--effort` for Haiku 4.5 and runs it at its default.
So five billed runs carried five rung labels none of them had, which is the failure ADR 0049 closed for an unknown rung.

## Decision

**A run is attempted when its CLI exited cleanly or made at least one model call.** `RunResult.attempted` states it.

**An unattempted run is an error, decided before the grader is asked.** `CellRun.grade` raises a `RunError` naming the CLI's own message, so the record's verdict is `error` and the evidence is still captured.
A run that called the model and then exited non-zero did attempt the task, and is graded as before.

**The catalogue can say a model takes no effort rung.** `effort = false` on a model in `models.toml`, or `effort=false` on an `xharness_models` line, sets `ModelSpec.takes_effort`.
Haiku 4.5 is marked so.

**A matrix entry naming a rung for such a model stops collection, before spend.** The refusal names the model and tells the reader to drop the rung.
The same model with no rung still collects.

## Consequences

A session limit, an expired login or a refused request now reads as an error on the report, not a regression of the skill.

The Haiku rows already captured at a rung keep their labels, because a replay carries a stored effort forward (ADR 0049).
No new Haiku cell can be recorded at a rung.

Whether a model honours effort is now a curated fact, settled by a sweep and recorded in the catalogue with the evidence beside it.

## Lens

A fail is a statement about the skill, so only a run that attempted the task can earn one.
A label is a statement about the run, so a setting the run never had must be refused, not recorded.
